name: SA-4503
summary: Cutamesine (SA 4503) is a synthetic sigma receptor agonist which is selective for the σ1 receptor, a chaperone protein mainly found in the endoplasmic reticulum of cells in the central nervous system. These σ1 receptors play a key role in the modulation of Ca2+ release and apoptosis.

pharmacology.text: Cutamesine (SA 4503) is a synthetic sigma receptor agonist which is selective for the σ1 receptor, a chaperone protein mainly found in the endoplasmic reticulum of cells in the central nervous system. Cutamesine's activation of the σ1 receptor is tied to a variety of physiological phenomena in the CNS, including activation of dopamine-releasing neurons and repression of the MAPK/ERK pathway.

uses.en: It has been studied in trials for recovery after stroke and for depression. It is not an approved medicine.
uses.zh: 它曾在中風後復原和憂鬱症的試驗中被研究，並不是核准的藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它曾在中风后复原和忧郁症的试验中被研究，并不是核准的药物。

fact.en: Cutamesine acts on the sigma-1 receptor, which is not a classic neurotransmitter receptor at all but a chaperone protein sitting on the membrane inside cells that helps other proteins fold.
fact.zh: Cutamesine 作用於 σ1 受體，而這根本不是典型的神經傳導物質受體，而是位於細胞內膜上的伴護蛋白，協助其他蛋白質正確折疊。
fact.zhHans: Cutamesine 作用于 σ1 受体，而这根本不是典型的神经传导物质受体，而是位于细胞内膜上的伴护蛋白，协助其他蛋白质正确折叠。
